# A mechanism the material shows carries further than the outcome it produced

## Statement
Where the material shows how something worked, the mechanism is what another
reader can use; the outcome belongs to the case it happened in.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-09 · `E-13.reader_path` — which candidate strategy survives selection.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the Knowledge Maintenance job: a record whose review is
months away, so that a pass has something it must not ask about.
